id-20260926-news-3.title: Regent of Gowa Named Suspect in Alleged Licensing Extortion, Assets Worth Rp5.58 Billion Seized

segments.src: Korps Pemberantasan Tindak Pidana Korupsi (Kortas Tipidkor) Polri menetapkan Bupati Gowa, Sitti Husniah Talenrang, sebagai tersangka dalam perkara dugaan pemerasan, gratifikasi, dan tindak pidana pencucian uang (TPPU).
segments.tr: The Indonesian National Police's Anti-Corruption and Criminal Investigation Corps (Kortas Tipidkor) has named the Regent of Gowa, Sitti Husniah Talenrang, as a suspect in a case of alleged extortion, gratuities, and money laundering (TPPU).

segments.src: Penetapan itu diumumkan penyidik dalam konferensi pers di Gedung Bareskrim Polri, Jakarta Selatan, Jumat (25/9/2026).
segments.tr: The designation was announced by investigators in a press conference at the Bareskrim Polri Building, South Jakarta, Friday (9/25/2026).

segments.src: Perkara ini mencakup empat rangkaian peristiwa yang diduga terjadi sepanjang 2025 hingga 2026 dan berkaitan dengan pengurusan izin di Kabupaten Gowa, Sulawesi Selatan.
segments.tr: This case encompasses four series of events that allegedly occurred throughout 2025 to 2026 and are related to licensing procedures in Gowa Regency, South Sulawesi.

segments.src: Hingga kini, semua uraian di bawah masih berstatus dugaan yang disampaikan penyidik dan belum diuji di pengadilan.
segments.tr: To date, all descriptions below remain alleged statements presented by investigators and have not been tested in court.

segments.src: ## Empat Rangkaian Dugaan
segments.tr: ## Four Series of Allegations

segments.src: Berdasarkan keterangan penyidik Kortas Tipidkor Polri, empat rangkaian dugaan tersebut adalah sebagai berikut.
segments.tr: Based on statements from the National Police's Kortas Tipidkor investigators, the four series of allegations are as follows.

segments.src: 1. **Pungutan pada pengurusan PKKPR.** Dalam pengurusan Persetujuan Kesesuaian Kegiatan Pemanfaatan Ruang (PKKPR), pengembang perumahan diduga diminta menyetor uang sekitar Rp1 juta hingga Rp1,5 juta untuk setiap unit rumah. Penyidik menyebut permintaan itu disampaikan melalui pejabat dinas terkait.
segments.tr: 1. **Levies on PKKPR processing.** In the processing of Space Utilization Activity Conformity Approval (PKKPR), housing developers were allegedly asked to deposit around Rp1 million to Rp1.5 million for each housing unit. Investigators stated that the request was conveyed through related departmental officials.

segments.src: 2. **Dana CSR gerai minimarket.** Penyidik menduga permintaan dana kepada Indomaret dilakukan dengan dalih tanggung jawab sosial perusahaan (CSR) sebesar Rp85 juta untuk setiap pembukaan gerai baru. Permintaan tersebut diduga disampaikan melalui seorang orang kepercayaan berinisial HA.
segments.tr: 2. **Mini-market outlet CSR funds.** Investigators suspect that the request for funds from Indomaret was carried out under the guise of corporate social responsibility (CSR) amounting to Rp85 million for each new outlet opening. This request was allegedly conveyed through a confidant with the initials HA.

segments.src: 3. **Diskon 70 persen rumah mewah.** Dalam pengurusan Persetujuan Bangunan Gedung (PBG) Perumahan Royal Spring, tersangka diduga meminta satu unit rumah senilai Rp1,4 miliar dengan potongan harga 70 persen sebagai syarat persetujuan.
segments.tr: 3. **70 percent discount on luxury houses.** In processing the Building Approval (PBG) for Royal Spring Housing, the suspect allegedly requested one house valued at Rp1.4 billion with a 70 percent price cut as a condition of approval.

segments.src: 4. **Dana sponsor pembukaan gerai.** Tersangka diduga meminta dana sponsor Rp100 juta kepada Indomaret untuk pembukaan gerai di kawasan Beautiful Malino.
segments.tr: 4. **Outlet opening sponsorship funds.** The suspect allegedly requested Rp100 million in sponsorship funds from Indomaret for the opening of an outlet in the Beautiful Malino area.

segments.src: ## Kaitan dengan Pengadaan Ambulans
segments.tr: ## Connection to Ambulance Procurement

segments.src: Penyidik juga menelusuri asal dana yang diduga dipakai untuk membayar rumah berdiskon tersebut.
segments.tr: Investigators are also tracing the origin of the funds allegedly used to pay for the discounted house.

segments.src: Menurut keterangan penyidik, dana itu diduga berasal dari imbalan (kickback) proyek pengadaan enam unit ambulans Dinas Kesehatan Gowa senilai Rp3,8 miliar yang dikerjakan PT API.
segments.tr: According to investigator statements, these funds are suspected to come from kickbacks on the procurement project for six Gowa Health Office ambulances worth Rp3.8 billion undertaken by PT API.

segments.src: Dugaan ini masih dalam pendalaman, termasuk aliran dananya.
segments.tr: This allegation is still under investigation, including the flow of funds.

segments.src: ## Aset Senilai Rp5,58 Miliar Disita
segments.tr: ## Assets Worth Rp5.58 Billion Seized

segments.src: Dalam penyidikan, Polri menyita aset yang diduga terkait perkara ini dengan total nilai sekitar Rp5,58 miliar.
segments.tr: During the investigation, the police seized assets allegedly related to this case with a total value of approximately Rp5.58 billion.

segments.src: Aset tersebut terdiri atas:
segments.tr: These assets consist of:

segments.src: | Aset | Perkiraan nilai |
segments.tr: | Asset | Estimated value |

segments.src: | Rumah di kawasan Royal Spring, Kabupaten Gowa | Rp1,4 miliar |
segments.tr: | House in the Royal Spring area, Gowa Regency | Rp1.4 billion |

segments.src: | Rumah di kawasan Waterfront, Makassar | Rp3,5 miliar |
segments.tr: | House in the Waterfront area, Makassar | Rp3.5 billion |

segments.src: | Satu unit Toyota HiAce keluaran 2025 | sekitar Rp682 juta |
segments.tr: | One unit of 2025 Toyota HiAce | approximately Rp682 million |

segments.src: Penyidik menyebut telah memeriksa puluhan saksi dan ahli serta melakukan penggeledahan di sejumlah lokasi sebelum menetapkan tersangka.
segments.tr: Investigators stated they had examined dozens of witnesses and experts as well as conducted searches at several locations before naming the suspect.

segments.src: ## Belum Ditahan, Pemeriksaan Menyusul
segments.tr: ## Not Yet Detained, Examination to Follow

segments.src: Sampai saat ini Sitti Husniah belum ditahan.
segments.tr: Until now, Sitti Husniah has not been detained.

segments.src: Penyidik menyatakan akan memanggil dan memeriksanya sebagai tersangka dalam waktu dekat.
segments.tr: Investigators stated they will summon and examine her as a suspect in the near future.

segments.src: Keputusan soal penahanan akan dinilai setelah pemeriksaan tersebut.
segments.tr: The decision regarding detention will be assessed after the examination.

segments.src: ## Polri: Tidak Ada Intervensi
segments.tr: ## Police: No Intervention

segments.src: Sitti Husniah diketahui merupakan adik mantan Astamaops Polri, Komjen (Purn) Fadil Imran.
segments.tr: Sitti Husniah is known to be the younger sister of former National Police Astamaops, Comr. Gen. (Ret.) Fadil Imran.

segments.src: Menanggapi hal itu, Direktur Penindakan Kortas Tipidkor Polri, Brigjen Robertus Yohanes De Deo, menegaskan bahwa hubungan keluarga tersebut tidak berpengaruh pada penanganan perkara.
segments.tr: Responding to this, the Director of Enforcement for the National Police's Kortas Tipidkor, Brig. Gen. Robertus Yohanes De Deo, emphasized that this family relationship has no effect on the handling of the case.

segments.src: Ia menyatakan tidak ada intervensi dalam proses penyidikan.
segments.tr: He stated there is no intervention in the investigative process.

segments.src: Pemberitaan sejumlah media juga menyebut Fadil Imran dan keluarga memilih tidak mencampuri proses hukum yang berjalan.
segments.tr: Reports from several media outlets also mention that Fadil Imran and his family chose not to interfere with the ongoing legal process.

segments.src: ## Asas Praduga Tak Bersalah
segments.tr: ## Presumption of Innocence

segments.src: Penetapan tersangka merupakan tahap awal dalam proses hukum, bukan putusan bersalah.
segments.tr: The naming of a suspect is an early stage in the legal process, not a verdict of guilt.

segments.src: Sitti Husniah berhak mendapat pembelaan dan dianggap tidak bersalah sampai ada putusan pengadilan yang berkekuatan hukum tetap.
segments.tr: Sitti Husniah has the right to defense and is considered innocent until there is a court decision with permanent legal force.

segments.src: Perkembangan perkara, termasuk pemeriksaan tersangka dan pasal yang akhirnya didakwakan, akan bergantung pada hasil penyidikan dan proses peradilan.
segments.tr: The development of the case, including the examination of the suspect and the articles ultimately charged, will depend on the results of the investigation and the judicial process.

segments.src: ## Mengapa Kasus Ini Menjadi Sorotan
segments.tr: ## Why This Case Has Become a Spotlight

segments.src: Perkara ini menyangkut layanan perizinan, yaitu pintu masuk bagi pengembang dan pelaku usaha yang ingin berinvestasi di daerah.
segments.tr: This case concerns licensing services, which are the gateway for developers and business actors wanting to invest in the region.

segments.src: Bila dugaan pungutan di luar ketentuan terbukti, biaya tambahan semacam itu berpotensi ikut membebani harga rumah dan iklim usaha setempat.
segments.tr: If the allegations of unauthorized levies are proven, such additional costs have the potential to burden house prices and the local business climate.

segments.src: Publik kini menunggu kelanjutan penyidikan, pemeriksaan tersangka, dan keterbukaan aparat dalam menjelaskan perkembangan perkara.
segments.tr: The public is now awaiting the continuation of the investigation, the examination of the suspect, and the transparency of authorities in explaining the development of the case.

segments.src: *Artikel ini disusun berdasarkan keterangan resmi Kortas Tipidkor Polri yang dilaporkan sejumlah media nasional pada 25 September 2026.
segments.tr: *This article was prepared based on official statements from the National Police's Kortas Tipidkor reported by several national media outlets on September 25, 2026.

segments.src: Informasi dapat berubah seiring perkembangan penyidikan.*
segments.tr: Information is subject to change as the investigation develops.*

id-20260926-news-1.title: IDX Allows Shares to Be Traded as Low as Rp1 Starting September 28, 2026, Here Is What Retail Investors Need to Understand

segments.src: Mulai Senin, 28 September 2026, Bursa Efek Indonesia (BEI) mengizinkan harga saham diperdagangkan serendah Rp1.
segments.tr: Starting Monday, September 28, 2026, the Indonesia Stock Exchange (IDX) is allowing stock prices to be traded as low as Rp1.

segments.src: Sebelumnya, batas harga terendah berada di Rp50.
segments.tr: Previously, the lowest price limit was Rp50.

segments.src: Perubahan ini memengaruhi cara pergerakan harga saham berharga sangat rendah, sehingga investor ritel perlu memahami mekanismenya sebelum mengambil keputusan.
segments.tr: This change affects how the price movement of very low-priced stocks behaves, making it essential for retail investors to understand the mechanism before making decisions.

segments.src: Aturan ini berlaku ketika pasar sedang bergerak turun.
segments.tr: This rule applies when the market is moving downward.

segments.src: Pada penutupan perdagangan Jumat (25/9/2026), Indeks Harga Saham Gabungan (IHSG) melemah 0,90 persen ke level 6.241.
segments.tr: At the close of trading on Friday (25/9/2026), the Jakarta Composite Index (IHSG) weakened by 0.90 percent to the 6,241 level.

segments.src: ## Poin Utama
segments.tr: ## Main Points

segments.src: - **Harga minimum saham turun dari Rp50 menjadi Rp1** mulai 28 September 2026.
segments.tr: - **The minimum stock price drops from Rp50 to Rp1** starting September 28, 2026.

segments.src: - **Untuk rentang harga Rp1 hingga Rp10, batas auto rejection atas (ARA) dan auto rejection bawah (ARB) masing-masing hanya Rp1.**
segments.tr: - **For the price range of Rp1 to Rp10, the upper auto rejection (ARA) and lower auto rejection (ARB) limits are each only Rp1.**

segments.src: - **ARB 15 persen tetap bersifat asimetris hingga akhir 2026**, sesuai penjelasan dalam pengumuman aturan tersebut.
segments.tr: - **The 15 percent ARB remains asymmetric until the end of 2026**, according to the explanation in the announcement of the rule.

segments.src: - IHSG ditutup turun 0,90 persen ke 6.241 pada Jumat (25/9/2026).
segments.tr: - The IHSG closed down 0.90 percent at 6,241 on Friday (25/9/2026).

segments.src: ## Apa yang Berubah?
segments.tr: ## What Has Changed?

segments.src: Selama ini, saham yang harganya berada di bawah Rp50 punya ruang gerak terbatas karena ada batas harga minimum.
segments.tr: Previously, stocks priced below Rp50 had limited room to move due to a minimum price limit.

segments.src: Dengan aturan baru, harga saham boleh berada di angka Rp1, Rp2, dan seterusnya sampai Rp49.
segments.tr: With the new rule, stock prices can be at Rp1, Rp2, and so on up to Rp49.

segments.src: Untuk kelompok saham di rentang Rp1 sampai Rp10, batas kenaikan (ARA) dan batas penurunan (ARB) dalam satu hari perdagangan dipatok Rp1.
segments.tr: For the group of stocks in the Rp1 to Rp10 range, the increase limit (ARA) and decrease limit (ARB) in a single trading day are pegged at Rp1.

segments.src: Artinya, satu hari perdagangan dibatasi pergerakan sebesar satu rupiah ke atas atau ke bawah.
segments.tr: This means a single trading day is limited to a movement of one rupiah upward or downward.

segments.src: Sekilas, angka Rp1 terlihat kecil.
segments.tr: At a glance, the figure of Rp1 looks small.

segments.src: Namun untuk saham berharga sangat rendah, Rp1 dapat berarti perubahan persentase yang besar.
segments.tr: However, for very low-priced stocks, Rp1 can mean a large percentage change.

segments.src: ## Ilustrasi: Rp1 Bisa Berarti Persentase Besar
segments.tr: ## Illustration: Rp1 Can Mean a Large Percentage

segments.src: Tabel berikut adalah hitungan sederhana untuk membantu memahami dampaknya.
segments.tr: The following table is a simple calculation to help understand the impact.

segments.src: Angka ini hanya ilustrasi, bukan proyeksi harga saham tertentu.
segments.tr: These figures are for illustration only, not a projection of any specific stock price.

segments.src: | Harga saham | Pergerakan Rp1 ke atas | Pergerakan Rp1 ke bawah |
segments.tr: | Stock Price | Rp1 upward movement | Rp1 downward movement |

segments.src: | Rp10 | naik ke Rp11 (sekitar 10%) | turun ke Rp9 (10%) |
segments.tr: | Rp10 | rises to Rp11 (about 10%) | drops to Rp9 (10%) |

segments.src: | Rp5 | naik ke Rp6 (20%) | turun ke Rp4 (20%) |
segments.tr: | Rp5 | rises to Rp6 (20%) | drops to Rp4 (20%) |

segments.src: | Rp2 | naik ke Rp3 (50%) | turun ke Rp1 (50%) |
segments.tr: | Rp2 | rises to Rp3 (50%) | drops to Rp1 (50%) |

segments.src: | Rp1 | naik ke Rp2 (100%) | tidak ada ruang di bawah Rp1 |
segments.tr: | Rp1 | rises to Rp2 (100%) | no room below Rp1 |

segments.src: Dari tabel terlihat bahwa batas Rp1 tidak otomatis berarti risiko kecil.
segments.tr: From the table, it is clear that the Rp1 limit does not automatically mean low risk.

segments.src: Semakin rendah harga saham, semakin besar dampak persentase dari satu langkah harga.
segments.tr: The lower the stock price, the greater the percentage impact of a single price step.

segments.src: Sebuah saham bisa tampak "murah", tetapi nilai investasinya dapat berubah drastis dalam waktu singkat.
segments.tr: A stock may look "cheap," but its investment value can change drastically in a short time.

segments.src: ## Mengapa Investor Ritel Perlu Waspada?
segments.tr: ## Why Do Retail Investors Need to Be Careful?

segments.src: Saham dengan harga sangat rendah sering disebut "saham gorengan" dalam percakapan sehari-hari di kalangan investor.
segments.tr: Stocks with very low prices are often called " gorengan stocks" in daily conversations among investors.

segments.src: Istilah ini umumnya merujuk pada saham yang harganya bergerak tajam dalam waktu singkat dan sering tidak selaras dengan kinerja perusahaannya.
segments.tr: This term generally refers to stocks whose prices move sharply in a short time and often do not align with the company's performance.

segments.src: Perlu dicatat, tidak semua saham berharga rendah masuk kategori tersebut, dan penilaian tiap saham harus didasarkan pada data, bukan sekadar harganya.
segments.tr: It should be noted that not all low-priced stocks fall into this category, and the assessment of each stock must be based on data, not just its price.

segments.src: Beberapa hal yang patut diperhatikan:
segments.tr: Several things to watch out for:

segments.src: 1. **Volatilitas persentase tinggi.** Satu langkah harga yang kecil dalam rupiah bisa menghasilkan lonjakan atau penurunan besar dalam persen.
segments.tr: 1. **High percentage volatility.** A small price step in rupiah can result in a large surge or drop in percentage.

segments.src: 2. **Likuiditas bisa tipis.** Pada saham yang sepi peminat, antrean jual dan beli dapat menumpuk. Saat harga bergerak tidak menguntungkan, investor mungkin sulit keluar pada harga yang diharapkan.
segments.tr: 2. **Liquidity can be thin.** In stocks with low interest, buy and sell queues can pile up. When prices move unfavorably, investors may find it difficult to exit at the expected price.

segments.src: 3. **Harga murah bukan berarti valuasi murah.** Harga per lembar yang rendah tidak menjelaskan apa pun tentang kesehatan keuangan perusahaan. Ukuran seperti laba, arus kas, utang, dan jumlah saham beredar tetap perlu dicek.
segments.tr: 3. **A cheap price does not mean cheap valuation.** A low per-share price explains nothing about the company's financial health. Metrics such as earnings, cash flow, debt, and outstanding shares still need to be checked.

segments.src: 4. **Risiko ikut-ikutan.** Keputusan yang didorong oleh unggahan di media sosial atau grup percakapan tanpa verifikasi rentan berujung kerugian.
segments.tr: 4. **Herding risk.** Decisions driven by social media posts or chat groups without verification are vulnerable to resulting in losses.

segments.src: 5. **Kondisi pasar sedang berfluktuasi.** Dengan IHSG yang turun 0,90 persen pada akhir pekan lalu, sentimen pasar bisa cepat berubah dan memperbesar gejolak pada saham-saham berkapitalisasi kecil.
segments.tr: 5. **Market conditions are fluctuating.** With the IHSG dropping 0.90 percent at the end of last week, market sentiment can change quickly and amplify volatility in small-cap stocks.

segments.src: ## Soal ARB 15 Persen yang Tetap Asimetris
segments.tr: ## Regarding the 15 Percent Asymmetric ARB

segments.src: Batas ARB sebesar 15 persen yang bersifat asimetris tetap dipertahankan hingga akhir 2026.
segments.tr: The 15 percent ARB limit, which is asymmetric, is maintained until the end of 2026.

segments.src: Asimetris berarti batas penurunan harian tidak sama dengan batas kenaikan harian.
segments.tr: Asymmetric means the daily downward limit is not the same as the daily upward limit.

segments.src: Investor sebaiknya memeriksa detail tabel batas harga per kelompok harga pada pengumuman resmi BEI agar tidak salah memahami batas yang berlaku untuk saham yang dimiliki atau diincar.
segments.tr: Investors should check the details of the price limit table per price group in the official IDX announcement to avoid misinterpreting the limits that apply to the stocks they own or target.

segments.src: ## Langkah Praktis Sebelum Membeli Saham Berharga Rendah
segments.tr: ## Practical Steps Before Buying Low-Priced Stocks

segments.src: - **Baca sumber resmi.** Periksa pengumuman BEI dan keterbukaan informasi perusahaan, termasuk laporan keuangan terbaru.
segments.tr: - **Read official sources.** Check IDX announcements and company disclosures, including the latest financial reports.

segments.src: - **Perhatikan notasi dan pengumuman khusus.** BEI secara berkala menerbitkan informasi tentang saham dengan aktivitas perdagangan tidak biasa dan notasi khusus. Informasi ini bisa menjadi bahan pertimbangan.
segments.tr: - **Pay attention to special notations and announcements.** The IDX periodically publishes information about stocks with unusual trading activity and special notations. This information can be a consideration.

segments.src: - **Tentukan batas risiko.** Alokasikan dana yang siap menanggung kerugian dan jangan menggunakan dana darurat atau uang pinjaman.
segments.tr: - **Set risk limits.** Allocate funds that are ready to bear losses and do not use emergency funds or borrowed money.

segments.src: - **Diversifikasi.** Hindari menaruh sebagian besar dana pada satu saham spekulatif.
segments.tr: - **Diversify.** Avoid putting most of your funds into a single speculative stock.

segments.src: - **Hati-hati dengan janji keuntungan.** Ajakan yang menjanjikan kenaikan pasti atau cepat patut dicurigai.
segments.tr: - **Beware of profit promises.** Invitations promising sure or quick gains should be treated with suspicion.

segments.src: - **Gunakan sekuritas terdaftar.** Pastikan transaksi dilakukan lewat perusahaan sekuritas dan aplikasi yang diawasi otoritas.
segments.tr: - **Use registered brokerages.** Ensure transactions are made through securities companies and applications supervised by authorities.

segments.src: ## Yang Perlu Dipantau ke Depan
segments.tr: ## What to Monitor Going Forward

segments.src: Beberapa hari pertama penerapan aturan ini akan menjadi ujian bagaimana pelaku pasar menyesuaikan diri.
segments.tr: The first few days of implementing this rule will be a test of how market participants adapt.

segments.src: Investor dapat mencermati volume transaksi, frekuensi perdagangan, dan pengumuman BEI terkait pengawasan pasar.
segments.tr: Investors can observe transaction volume, trading frequency, and IDX announcements related to market surveillance.

segments.src: Evaluasi ketentuan asimetris ARB menjelang akhir 2026 juga layak diikuti, karena bisa memengaruhi cara pasar bergerak pada tahun berikutnya.
segments.tr: The evaluation of the ARB asymmetric provisions towards the end of 2026 is also worth following, as it could affect how the market moves the following year.

segments.src: ## Kesimpulan
segments.tr: ## Conclusion

segments.src: Batas harga terendah Rp1 memberi ruang perdagangan baru di pasar saham Indonesia, tetapi juga menuntut kehati-hatian lebih besar dari investor ritel.
segments.tr: The Rp1 lowest price limit provides new trading room in the Indonesian stock market, but also demands greater caution from retail investors.

segments.src: Batas ARA dan ARB Rp1 di rentang Rp1–Rp10 terlihat kecil dalam rupiah, namun dampaknya dalam persen bisa besar.
segments.tr: The ARA and ARB limits of Rp1 in the Rp1–Rp10 range look small in rupiah, but their impact in percentage can be large.

segments.src: Kenali produk yang dibeli, cek data resmi, dan sesuaikan keputusan dengan profil risiko masing-masing.
segments.tr: Know the products you buy, check official data, and match your decisions to your respective risk profiles.

segments.src: *Catatan: Artikel ini bersifat informasi umum dan bukan ajakan, rekomendasi, atau nasihat untuk membeli atau menjual saham tertentu.
segments.tr: *Note: This article is for general information and is not an invitation, recommendation, or advice to buy or sell specific stocks.

segments.src: Semua keputusan investasi menjadi tanggung jawab masing-masing investor.
segments.tr: All investment decisions are the responsibility of each investor.

segments.src: Rujuk pengumuman resmi BEI untuk ketentuan terbaru.*
segments.tr: Refer to official IDX announcements for the latest provisions.*

id-20260926-news-2.title: Prabowo Approves National Peatland and Mangrove Management Agency Under the President: Can It Break the Forest and Land Fire Cycle?

segments.src: Setelah berdiskusi sekitar empat jam dengan lebih dari 20 peneliti dan ahli gambut di Istana, Presiden Prabowo Subianto dilaporkan menyetujui pembentukan **Badan Pengelola Gambut dan Mangrove Nasional (BPGMN)**.
segments.tr: After discussing for about four hours with more than 20 peatland researchers and experts at the Palace, President Prabowo Subianto reportedly agreed to the establishment of the **National Peatland and Mangrove Management Agency (BPGMN)**.

segments.src: Badan ini dirancang untuk menyatukan pengelolaan data, perizinan, pengelolaan lahan, dan pemetaan ekosistem gambut serta mangrove dalam satu jalur koordinasi di bawah presiden.
segments.tr: This agency is designed to unify data management, licensing, land management, and the mapping of peat and mangrove ecosystems in a single coordination line under the president.

segments.src: Kabar ini menarik perhatian karena kebakaran hutan dan lahan (karhutla) hampir selalu muncul kembali setiap musim kemarau, terutama di kawasan gambut.
segments.tr: This news has drawn attention because forest and land fires (karhutla) almost always recur every dry season, especially in peat areas.

segments.src: Pertanyaannya, apakah satu lembaga baru cukup untuk mengubah pola yang sudah berulang bertahun-tahun?
segments.tr: The question is, will a single new institution be enough to change a pattern that has repeated for years?

segments.src: ## Apa yang Disepakati
segments.tr: ## What Was Agreed

segments.src: Berdasarkan informasi yang beredar, pertemuan di Istana itu mempertemukan Presiden dengan para peneliti dan ahli gambut dari berbagai latar belakang keilmuan.
segments.tr: Based on circulating information, the meeting at the Palace brought the President together with researchers and peat experts from various scientific backgrounds.

segments.src: Hasilnya, Presiden setuju membentuk badan khusus yang menangani dua ekosistem sekaligus, yaitu gambut dan mangrove.
segments.tr: As a result, the President agreed to form a special agency to handle two ecosystems simultaneously, namely peat and mangroves.

segments.src: Empat fungsi utama yang disebut akan disatukan dalam badan ini:
segments.tr: Four main functions that are said to be unified in this agency:

segments.src: - **Data**: satu basis data yang menjadi rujukan bersama, sehingga tidak ada lagi angka luas gambut atau mangrove yang berbeda antarinstansi.
segments.tr: - **Data**: a single database that serves as a joint reference, so there are no longer differing figures on the area of peat or mangroves between institutions.

segments.src: - **Perizinan**: keputusan pemanfaatan lahan yang selaras dengan kondisi ekologis kawasan.
segments.tr: - **Licensing**: land-use decisions that align with the ecological conditions of the area.

segments.src: - **Pengelolaan**: pemulihan, pembasahan kembali (rewetting), dan perlindungan ekosistem secara terpadu.
segments.tr: - **Management**: integrated restoration, rewetting, and ecosystem protection.

segments.src: - **Pemetaan**: peta gambut dan mangrove yang mutakhir dan dapat dipakai lintas sektor.
segments.tr: - **Mapping**: up-to-date peat and mangrove maps that can be used across sectors.

segments.src: Detail lain, seperti dasar hukum, struktur organisasi, kewenangan, dan anggaran, belum dapat dipastikan dan akan bergantung pada aturan resmi yang diterbitkan pemerintah.
segments.tr: Other details, such as legal basis, organizational structure, authority, and budget, cannot yet be ascertained and will depend on official regulations issued by the government.

segments.src: ## Mengapa Gambut Begitu Rentan
segments.tr: ## Why Peat Is So Vulnerable

segments.src: Gambut adalah lahan basah yang terbentuk dari timbunan sisa tumbuhan selama ribuan tahun.
segments.tr: Peat is a wetland formed from the accumulation of plant remains over thousands of years.

segments.src: Dalam kondisi alaminya yang tergenang air, gambut menyimpan karbon dalam jumlah besar dan sulit terbakar.
segments.tr: In its natural waterlogged condition, peat stores large amounts of carbon and is difficult to burn.

segments.src: Masalah muncul ketika lahan dikeringkan melalui kanal atau drainase.
segments.tr: The problem arises when land is drained through canals or drainage systems.

segments.src: Gambut yang kering mudah menyala, apinya dapat merambat di bawah permukaan, dan pemadamannya memakan waktu lama serta biaya besar.
segments.tr: Dry peat easily ignites, the fire can spread below the surface, and extinguishing it takes a long time and high costs.

segments.src: Asap dari kebakaran gambut berdampak luas: mengganggu kesehatan warga, menghambat aktivitas sekolah dan transportasi, serta kerap dirasakan hingga lintas wilayah.
segments.tr: Smoke from peat fires has widespread impacts: disrupting residents' health, hindering school and transportation activities, and often being felt across regions.

segments.src: Karena itu, para ahli sering menekankan bahwa pencegahan, yakni menjaga gambut tetap basah, jauh lebih efektif daripada pemadaman setelah api membesar.
segments.tr: Therefore, experts often emphasize that prevention—keeping peat wet—is much more effective than extinguishing fires after they grow large.

segments.src: ## Peran Mangrove
segments.tr: ## The Role of Mangroves

segments.src: Mangrove berada di kelompok ekosistem yang berbeda, tetapi memiliki kaitan erat dengan agenda yang sama.
segments.tr: Mangroves belong to a different ecosystem group, but are closely linked to the same agenda.

segments.src: Hutan mangrove melindungi garis pantai dari abrasi, menjadi tempat berkembang biak berbagai biota laut, dan menyimpan karbon dalam jumlah signifikan.
segments.tr: Mangrove forests protect coastlines from abrasion, serve as breeding grounds for various marine biota, and store significant amounts of carbon.

segments.src: Menggabungkan pengelolaan gambut dan mangrove dalam satu badan mencerminkan pendekatan bahwa keduanya adalah ekosistem penyimpan karbon yang perlu dikelola dengan tata kelola yang konsisten.
segments.tr: Combining peat and mangrove management into a single agency reflects the approach that both are carbon-storing ecosystems that need to be managed with consistent governance.

segments.src: ## Mengapa Badan Terpadu Dinilai Penting
segments.tr: ## Why an Integrated Agency Is Considered Important

segments.src: Selama ini, pengelolaan gambut kerap disorot karena tanggung jawabnya tersebar di beberapa kementerian, lembaga, dan pemerintah daerah.
segments.tr: So far, peat management has often been highlighted because its responsibilities are spread across several ministries, institutions, and local governments.

segments.src: Kondisi seperti itu berpotensi menimbulkan beberapa persoalan:
segments.tr: Such a condition has the potential to cause several issues:

segments.src: 1. **Data tidak seragam.** Perbedaan peta dan angka dapat membuat kebijakan tidak tepat sasaran.
segments.tr: 1. **Inconsistent data.** Differences in maps and figures can make policies misdirected.

segments.src: 2. **Perizinan dan pengawasan tidak selalu sejalan.** Izin pemanfaatan lahan bisa terbit tanpa memperhitungkan fungsi hidrologis gambut secara utuh.
segments.tr: 2. **Licensing and supervision do not always align.** Land-use permits can be issued without fully considering the hydrological function of peat.

segments.src: 3. **Koordinasi lemah.** Restorasi di satu wilayah dapat terganggu oleh pengelolaan air di wilayah sekitarnya.
segments.tr: 3. **Weak coordination.** Restoration in one area can be disrupted by water management in surrounding areas.

segments.src: Dengan berada langsung di bawah presiden, badan ini diharapkan memiliki posisi koordinasi yang cukup kuat untuk menyelaraskan berbagai kepentingan tersebut.
segments.tr: By being directly under the president, this agency is expected to have a coordination position strong enough to harmonize these various interests.

segments.src: ## Tantangan yang Masih Menunggu
segments.tr: ## Challenges That Still Lie Ahead

segments.src: Meski arah kebijakannya dinilai positif, keberhasilan badan baru tidak ditentukan oleh pembentukannya semata.
segments.tr: Although the policy direction is considered positive, the success of the new agency is not determined by its formation alone.

segments.src: Sejumlah hal yang patut dicermati ke depan:
segments.tr: A number of things to watch out for in the future:

segments.src: - **Kejelasan mandat dan kewenangan.** Badan yang kuat di atas kertas tetap perlu wewenang nyata untuk mengoordinasikan atau menyelaraskan keputusan lintas sektor.
segments.tr: - **Clarity of mandate and authority.** An agency that is strong on paper still needs real authority to coordinate or harmonize cross-sector decisions.

segments.src: - **Pendanaan yang memadai dan berkelanjutan.** Restorasi gambut dan rehabilitasi mangrove membutuhkan kerja jangka panjang, bukan program satu-dua musim.
segments.tr: - **Adequate and sustainable funding.** Peat restoration and mangrove rehabilitation require long-term work, not a one- or two-season program.

segments.src: - **Pelibatan masyarakat.** Warga sekitar gambut, petani, dan komunitas pesisir adalah pihak yang paling dekat dengan lahan. Alternatif mata pencaharian yang tidak merusak ekosistem menjadi kunci.
segments.tr: - **Community involvement.** Residents around peatlands, farmers, and coastal communities are the parties closest to the land. Alternative livelihoods that do not damage the ecosystem are the key.

segments.src: - **Penegakan aturan dan transparansi.** Data dan hasil pemantauan yang terbuka membantu publik menilai kemajuan secara objektif.
segments.tr: - **Rule enforcement and transparency.** Open data and monitoring results help the public evaluate progress objectively.

segments.src: - **Keselarasan dengan lembaga yang sudah ada.** Pembagian peran dengan kementerian dan badan terkait perlu dirumuskan agar tidak menimbulkan tumpang tindih baru.
segments.tr: - **Alignment with existing institutions.** The division of roles with relevant ministries and agencies needs to be formulated to avoid creating new overlaps.

segments.src: ## Bisakah Karhutla Berulang Dicegah?
segments.tr: ## Can Recurring Fires Be Prevented?

segments.src: Jawaban jujurnya: badan terpadu dapat menjadi fondasi yang penting, tetapi bukan solusi tunggal.
segments.tr: The honest answer: an integrated agency can be an important foundation, but not a single solution.

segments.src: Karhutla dipengaruhi banyak faktor, mulai dari kondisi cuaca dan musim kemarau panjang, tata kelola air di lahan gambut, praktik pembukaan lahan, hingga pengawasan di lapangan.
segments.tr: Fires are influenced by many factors, ranging from weather conditions and long dry seasons, water management on peatlands, land-clearing practices, to supervision in the field.

segments.src: Efektivitas BPGMN baru akan terlihat dari hal-hal konkret: apakah data benar-benar terintegrasi, apakah kanal-kanal di gambut dibasahi kembali, apakah perizinan dievaluasi, dan apakah jumlah titik api menurun dari musim ke musim.
segments.tr: The effectiveness of BPGMN will only be seen from concrete things: whether data is truly integrated, whether canals in peatlands are rewet, whether permits are evaluated, and whether the number of hotspots decreases from season to season.

segments.src: Untuk saat ini, langkah pemerintah menghimpun masukan dari para peneliti dan ahli dapat dibaca sebagai sinyal bahwa kebijakan gambut dan mangrove ingin bertumpu pada dasar ilmiah.
segments.tr: For now, the government's step of gathering input from researchers and experts can be read as a signal that peat and mangrove policies want to rely on a scientific basis.

segments.src: Publik kini menunggu aturan pelaksananya serta bukti nyata di lapangan.
segments.tr: The public is now awaiting implementing regulations and real evidence in the field.

id-20260926-intro-retail-8.title: [Retail #8] Store Shelves Aren't Filled Randomly: The Basics of Merchandising

segments.src: > Merchandising adalah seni sekaligus hitungan: menyiapkan barang yang tepat, dalam jumlah yang tepat, di tempat dan waktu yang tepat, dengan harga yang tepat — supaya uang toko tidak mengendap jadi tumpukan stok.
segments.tr: > Merchandising is both an art and a calculation: preparing the right goods, in the right quantities, at the right place and time, and at the right price — so that store cash doesn't get tied up in stacked inventory.

segments.src: ## Konsep Hari Ini
segments.tr: ## Today's Concept

segments.src: Bayangkan Anda punya modal Rp 100 juta dan sebuah toko.
segments.tr: Imagine you have a capital of Rp 100 million and a store.

segments.src: Pertanyaan pertama bukan "bagaimana cara jualan?", tapi **"barang apa saja yang saya taruh di rak, dan berapa banyak?"** Jawaban atas pertanyaan itulah yang disebut **merchandising**.
segments.tr: The first question isn't "how to sell?", but **"what items do I put on the shelf, and how many?"** The answer to that question is called **merchandising**.

segments.src: Di dunia ritel, merchandising sering diringkas jadi lima "tepat":
segments.tr: In the retail world, merchandising is often summarized into five "rights":

segments.src: 1. **Produk yang tepat** — sesuai kebutuhan pelanggan di sekitar toko.
segments.tr: 1. **Right product** — matching customer needs around the store.

segments.src: 2. **Jumlah yang tepat** — tidak kehabisan, tidak menumpuk.
segments.tr: 2. **Right quantity** — no stockouts, no overstock.

segments.src: 3. **Tempat yang tepat** — cabang mana, rak mana.
segments.tr: 3. **Right place** — which branch, which shelf.

segments.src: 4. **Waktu yang tepat** — barang Lebaran datang sebelum Ramadan, bukan sesudah.
segments.tr: 4. **Right time** — Eid goods arrive before Ramadan, not after.

segments.src: 5. **Harga yang tepat** — masih untung, tapi masuk akal bagi pembeli.
segments.tr: 5. **Right price** — still profitable, but makes sense for the buyer.

segments.src: Pekerjaan ini biasanya dipecah menjadi tiga bagian besar.
segments.tr: This work is usually broken down into three major parts.

segments.src: **Pertama, komposisi produk (assortment).** Ini soal *apa saja* yang dijual.
segments.tr: **First, product composition (assortment).** This is about *what* is sold.

segments.src: Dua ukurannya:
segments.tr: Two measures:

segments.src: - **Lebar (breadth)**: berapa banyak jenis/kategori yang ditawarkan. Minimarket punya lebar besar — dari mi instan sampai pulsa.
segments.tr: - **Breadth**: how many types/categories are offered. Minimarkets have great breadth — from instant noodles to phone credit.

segments.src: - **Kedalaman (depth)**: berapa banyak pilihan di dalam satu kategori. Toko khusus kopi punya kedalaman besar — 20 jenis biji Gayo, Toraja, Kintamani.
segments.tr: - **Depth**: how many choices are within a single category. Specialty coffee shops have great depth — 20 types of Gayo, Toraja, Kintamani beans.

segments.src: Tidak ada toko yang bisa lebar sekaligus dalam tanpa batas, karena rak dan modal terbatas.
segments.tr: No store can be both wide and deep infinitely, because shelves and capital are limited.

segments.src: Memilih posisi di antara keduanya adalah keputusan strategis.
segments.tr: Choosing a position between the two is a strategic decision.

segments.src: Satuan terkecil yang dihitung namanya **SKU** (*stock keeping unit*): kaus merek A, warna hitam, ukuran L adalah satu SKU; warna putih ukuran L adalah SKU yang lain.
segments.tr: The smallest unit counted is called an **SKU** (*stock keeping unit*): brand A t-shirt, black color, size L is one SKU; white color size L is another SKU.

segments.src: **Kedua, perencanaan barang (merchandise planning).** Ini soal *berapa banyak dan kapan*.
segments.tr: **Second, merchandise planning.** This is about *how much and when*.

segments.src: Intinya menerjemahkan target penjualan menjadi rencana belanja.
segments.tr: Essentially translating sales targets into purchasing plans.

segments.src: Alat klasiknya bernama **Open-to-Buy (OTB)** — anggaran belanja yang masih tersisa untuk satu periode, dihitung dalam nilai harga jual:
segments.tr: The classic tool is called **Open-to-Buy (OTB)** — remaining purchase budget for a period, calculated in retail price value:

segments.src: OTB = rencana penjualan + target stok akhir + rencana diskon − stok awal
segments.tr: OTB = rencana penjualan + target stok akhir + rencana diskon − stok awal

segments.src: Kalau hasilnya kecil atau minus, artinya gudang sudah terlalu penuh: jangan belanja lagi, jualan dulu.
segments.tr: If the result is small or negative, it means the warehouse is too full: stop shopping, sell first.

segments.src: **Ketiga, pembelian (buying).** Ini eksekusinya: memilih pemasok, menawar harga dan syarat pembayaran, menghitung **lead time** (jeda dari pesan sampai barang datang) dan **MOQ** (jumlah pesanan minimum), lalu menerbitkan pesanan pembelian.
segments.tr: **Third, buying.** This is the execution: choosing suppliers, negotiating prices and payment terms, calculating **lead time** (gap from order to arrival) and **MOQ** (minimum order quantity), then issuing purchase orders.

segments.src: Buyer yang baik bukan yang paling jago menawar, tapi yang paling paham kapan harus berhenti membeli.
segments.tr: A good buyer isn't the best at bargaining, but the one who best understands when to stop buying.

segments.src: Untuk mengukur hasilnya, dua angka paling sering dipakai:
segments.tr: To measure the results, two figures are most often used:

segments.src: Sell-through (%) = unit terjual ÷ unit yang disediakan × 100
segments.tr: Sell-through (%) = unit terjual ÷ unit yang disediakan × 100

segments.src: GMROI = margin kotor ÷ rata-rata nilai persediaan (harga pokok)
segments.tr: GMROI = margin kotor ÷ rata-rata nilai persediaan (harga pokok)

segments.src: Sell-through menjawab "laku berapa persen?", GMROI menjawab "tiap Rp 1 yang saya tanam di stok, balik jadi berapa rupiah margin?"
segments.tr: Sell-through answers "what percentage sold?", GMROI answers "every Rp 1 I plant in stock, returns how many rupiahs in margin?"

segments.src: ## Dalam Keseharian
segments.tr: ## In Daily Life

segments.src: Bu Sinta punya toko busana muslim di Bekasi.
segments.tr: Mrs. Sinta owns a Muslim fashion store in Bekasi.

segments.src: Menjelang Ramadan, ia menghadapi keputusan merchandising yang lengkap.
segments.tr: Ahead of Ramadan, she faces a complete merchandising decision.

segments.src: **Komposisi produk.** Tokonya kecil, jadi ia memilih lima kategori saja: baju koko, gamis, mukena, sarung, dan peci — lebarnya sempit, tapi dalam.
segments.tr: **Product composition.** Her store is small, so she chose just five categories: koko shirts, gamis, prayer sets (mukena), sarongs, and prayer caps (peci) — narrow in breadth, but deep.

segments.src: Untuk baju koko ia menyediakan 3 merek × 3 warna × 4 ukuran = 36 SKU.
segments.tr: For koko shirts, she provides 3 brands × 3 colors × 4 sizes = 36 SKUs.

segments.src: Ia sengaja tidak menjual sajadah dan parfum, meski banyak yang menawarkan, karena rak dan modalnya lebih menguntungkan bila dipakai untuk kategori inti.
segments.tr: She deliberately doesn't sell prayer rugs and perfume, even though many offer them, because her shelves and capital are more profitable when used for core categories.

segments.src: **Perencanaan.** Target penjualan bulan Ramadan: Rp 120 juta.
segments.tr: **Planning.** Ramadan sales target: Rp 120 million.

segments.src: Ia ingin menyisakan stok akhir senilai Rp 60 juta (buat jualan sesudah Lebaran), memperkirakan diskon akhir musim Rp 10 juta, dan stok awal di tokonya bernilai Rp 70 juta.
segments.tr: She wants to leave ending inventory worth Rp 60 million (to sell after Eid), estimates end-of-season discounts at Rp 10 million, and beginning inventory in her store is worth Rp 70 million.

segments.src: OTB = 120 juta + 60 juta + 10 juta − 70 juta = Rp 120 juta (nilai harga jual)
segments.tr: OTB = 120 juta + 60 juta + 10 juta − 70 juta = Rp 120 juta (nilai harga jual)

segments.src: Karena margin kotornya sekitar 40%, Rp 120 juta harga jual itu setara belanja sekitar Rp 72 juta di harga modal.
segments.tr: Since her gross margin is around 40%, the Rp 120 million retail price equates to about Rp 72 million in cost of goods.

segments.src: Itulah pagar anggarannya — bukan "sebanyak yang uangnya ada".
segments.tr: That is her budget fence — not "as much as money is available".

segments.src: **Pembelian.** Ia berangkat ke Tanah Abang.
segments.tr: **Buying.** She goes to Tanah Abang.

segments.src: Seorang pemasok menawarkan mukena dengan harga Rp 85.000 per potong bila ambil 100 potong, atau Rp 72.000 bila ambil 500 potong.
segments.tr: A supplier offers prayer sets at Rp 85,000 per piece if taking 100 pieces, or Rp 72,000 if taking 500 pieces.

segments.src: Selisihnya menggoda: hemat Rp 13.000 per potong.
segments.tr: The difference is tempting: save Rp 13,000 per piece.

segments.src: Tapi 500 potong berarti Rp 36 juta — separuh anggaran belanjanya habis di satu SKU, dan lead time pemasok itu 3 minggu, terlalu mepet dengan puncak belanja Lebaran.
segments.tr: But 500 pieces means Rp 36 million — half her purchase budget spent on a single SKU, and the supplier's lead time is 3 weeks, cutting it too close to the peak Eid shopping.

segments.src: Bu Sinta ambil 300 potong.
segments.tr: Mrs. Sinta takes 300 pieces.

segments.src: Tiga minggu kemudian terjual 240 potong.
segments.tr: Three weeks later, 240 pieces are sold.

segments.src: Sisa 60 potong ia diskon 30% di minggu terakhir dan habis sebelum Lebaran.
segments.tr: The remaining 60 pieces she discounts by 30% in the final week and they sell out before Eid.

segments.src: Seandainya ia ambil 500, sisanya 260 potong — barang bermotif Ramadan yang harus menginap setahun di gudang, sambil menahan uang yang seharusnya bisa berputar.
segments.tr: Had she taken 500, the remaining 260 pieces — Ramadan-themed items that would have to sleep a year in the warehouse, holding back cash that should be turning over.

segments.src: Diskon besar tadi bukan kegagalan; itu bagian dari rencana yang sudah ia anggarkan sejak awal.
segments.tr: That heavy discount wasn't a failure; it was part of the plan she budgeted from the start.

segments.src: ## Rangkuman 3 Baris
segments.tr: ## 3-Line Summary

segments.src: 1. Merchandising = menentukan barang apa, berapa banyak, kapan, di mana, dan dengan harga berapa — bukan sekadar mengisi rak.
segments.tr: 1. Merchandising = determining what goods, how much, when, where, and at what price — not just filling shelves.

segments.src: 2. Komposisi produk diukur lewat **lebar** (banyak kategori) dan **kedalaman** (banyak pilihan per kategori); rak dan modal yang terbatas memaksa kita memilih.
segments.tr: 2. Product composition is measured through **breadth** (number of categories) and **depth** (number of choices per category); limited shelves and capital force us to choose.

segments.src: 3. Perencanaan (lewat OTB) memasang pagar anggaran, pembelian mengeksekusinya, lalu sell-through dan GMROI menilai apakah keputusannya benar.
segments.tr: 3. Planning (via OTB) sets budget fences, buying executes them, then sell-through and GMROI assess if decisions were correct.

segments.src: ## ✅ Kuis Mandiri
segments.tr: ## ✅ Self Quiz

segments.src: **1.** Sebuah toko menjual 40 jenis biji kopi tetapi tidak menjual barang lain.
segments.tr: **1.** A store sells 40 types of coffee beans but sells no other goods.

segments.src: Ini adalah contoh komposisi produk yang…
segments.tr: This is an example of product composition that is...

segments.src: - (A) lebar besar, kedalaman kecil
segments.tr: - (A) wide breadth, small depth

segments.src: - (B) lebar kecil, kedalaman besar
segments.tr: - (B) small breadth, great depth

segments.src: - (C) lebar besar, kedalaman besar
segments.tr: - (C) wide breadth, great depth

segments.src: - (D) lebar kecil, kedalaman kecil
segments.tr: - (D) small breadth, small depth

segments.src: **2.** (Benar / Salah) Kalau perhitungan Open-to-Buy menghasilkan angka mendekati nol atau minus, itu tanda toko sebaiknya segera menambah pesanan barang.
segments.tr: **2.** (True / False) If the Open-to-Buy calculation yields a number close to zero or negative, it's a sign the store should immediately increase merchandise orders.

segments.src: **3.** Sebuah toko menyediakan 500 kaus dan terjual 350 potong.
segments.tr: **3.** A store provides 500 t-shirts and sells 350 pieces.

segments.src: Berapa sell-through-nya?
segments.tr: What is the sell-through rate?

segments.src: ## 📚 Istilah Hari Ini
segments.tr: ## 📚 Today's Terms

segments.src: - **Merchandising** — rangkaian keputusan tentang produk apa yang dijual, berapa banyak, kapan, di mana, dan dengan harga berapa.
segments.tr: - **Merchandising** — a series of decisions about what products to sell, how much, when, where, and at what price.

segments.src: - **Assortment (komposisi produk)** — susunan barang yang ditawarkan sebuah toko, diukur lewat lebar (jumlah kategori) dan kedalaman (jumlah pilihan per kategori).
segments.tr: - **Assortment (product composition)** — the arrangement of goods offered by a store, measured by breadth (number of categories) and depth (number of choices per category).

segments.src: - **SKU** — satuan terkecil pengelolaan stok; satu kombinasi unik merek–model–warna–ukuran.
segments.tr: - **SKU** — smallest stock management unit; a unique brand–model–color–size combination.

segments.src: - **Open-to-Buy (OTB)** — sisa anggaran belanja untuk satu periode, dihitung dari rencana penjualan, stok awal, target stok akhir, dan rencana diskon.
segments.tr: - **Open-to-Buy (OTB)** — remaining purchase budget for a period, calculated from sales plan, beginning inventory, target ending inventory, and discount plan.

segments.src: - **Sell-through** — persentase barang yang terjual dari total yang disediakan dalam satu periode.
segments.tr: - **Sell-through** — percentage of goods sold out of the total provided in a period.

segments.src: - **GMROI** — margin kotor dibagi rata-rata nilai persediaan (harga pokok); mengukur seberapa produktif uang yang tertanam di stok.
segments.tr: - **GMROI** — gross margin divided by average inventory value (cost price); measures how productively money tied up in stock is.

segments.src: *Jawaban: 1) B — banyak pilihan di dalam satu kategori berarti kedalaman besar, sementara hanya menjual satu kategori berarti lebar kecil.
segments.tr: *Answer: 1) B — many choices within a single category means great depth, while selling only one category means small breadth.

segments.src: 2) Salah — OTB mendekati nol atau minus artinya stok sudah melebihi rencana; yang perlu dilakukan adalah menjual atau mengurangi stok, bukan menambah pesanan.
segments.tr: 2) False — OTB close to zero or negative means inventory has exceeded plans; what needs to be done is sell or reduce stock, not increase orders.
